definitionEn: the list of students in a class; to mark who is present
example: The teacher takes the register at the start of the lesson.

definitionEn: not at school
example: Three students were absent on Monday.

definitionEn: at school or in the lesson
example: Is everyone present today?

definitionEn: arriving after the correct time
example: If you are late, go to the office first.

definitionEn: at the correct time, not late
example: Please be on time for the exam.

definitionEn: a meeting of the whole school, often in the hall
example: Assembly is in the hall every Monday morning.

definitionEn: a short rest between two lessons
example: We eat a snack at break.

definitionEn: the longer midday rest when students eat
example: The lunch break lasts forty minutes.

definitionEn: an activity at school after lessons finish
example: He goes to an after-school club for chess.

definitionEn: a small book for writing down homework
example: Write the task in your homework diary.

definitionEn: a book of empty pages for writing schoolwork
example: Open your exercise book on a new page.

definitionEn: the main book used for a subject
example: Leave your textbook at home tomorrow — we will use worksheets.

definitionEn: a book of printed exercises
example: Do page twelve in the workbook.

definitionEn: a single paper with exercises
example: Complete the worksheet in silence.

definitionEn: a cover for keeping loose papers together
example: Put the test in your folder.

definitionEn: a small bag for pens and pencils
example: There is no rubber in my pencil case.

definitionEn: a small object for removing pencil marks
example: Can I borrow your rubber?

definitionEn: a straight tool for drawing lines and measuring
example: Use a ruler to underline the title.

definitionEn: a bright pen for marking important words
example: Highlight key dates with a highlighter.

definitionEn: a stick of glue for paper
example: Use a glue stick, not liquid glue.

definitionEn: a tool with two blades for cutting paper
example: Pass the scissors to the next pair.

definitionEn: a large computer screen the teacher writes on
example: The map is on the interactive whiteboard.

definitionEn: a room full of computers for lessons
example: IT is in the computer lab on the first floor.

definitionEn: a room for experiments
example: Wear goggles in the science lab.

definitionEn: a large room for PE
example: PE is in the gym when it rains.

definitionEn: rooms where you change clothes for PE
example: Leave bags in the changing rooms.

definitionEn: a large outdoor grass area for sport
example: Football is on the playing field.

definitionEn: a board where information is pinned up
example: The trip list is on the noticeboard.

definitionEn: the room where school secretaries work
example: Collect your certificate from the school office.

definitionEn: a man in charge of a school
example: The headmaster spoke at assembly.

definitionEn: a woman in charge of a school
example: The headmistress will visit our lesson today.

definitionEn: the second person in charge of a school
example: See the deputy head if the headteacher is away.

definitionEn: the person who looks after the school building
example: Ask the caretaker if the hall is free.

definitionEn: a student in the same class
example: Sit with a classmate you can work with.

definitionEn: all the students of the same school year
example: Year eight is the last year group in this school.

definitionEn: a class with stronger and weaker students together
example: We are in a mixed ability English group.

definitionEn: a class grouped by how good students are at a subject
example: She is in the top set for maths.

definitionEn: a main subject such as maths, English or science
example: English is a core subject in year eight.

definitionEn: a language that is not your first language
example: German is her second foreign language.

definitionEn: the school subject of drawing and painting
example: We painted landscapes in art.

definitionEn: the school subject of singing and instruments
example: There is a test on notes in music.

definitionEn: the school subject about the past
example: In history we learned about the Second World War.

definitionEn: the school subject about the Earth, countries and maps
example: Geography homework is a map of Europe.

definitionEn: the science of living things
example: We studied the human heart in biology.

definitionEn: the science of substances and reactions
example: Chemistry experiments must be done carefully.

definitionEn: the science of energy, forces and motion
example: Physics explains why the bridge does not fall.

definitionEn: lessons about computers and technology
example: Save your work at the end of ICT.

definitionEn: lessons about rights, rules and life in society
example: In citizenship we talked about voting.

definitionEn: the class that meets with one tutor for registration
example: My tutor group is 8B.

definitionEn: a period of teaching, usually 45 minutes
example: The next lesson is English.

definitionEn: one numbered slot in the school day
example: Period five is PE on Wednesday.

definitionEn: the sound that starts and ends lessons
example: Do not pack your bag before the bell.

definitionEn: a long passage between classrooms
example: Walk, do not run, in the corridor.

definitionEn: a room where a class has lessons
example: Our classroom is number twelve.

definitionEn: a table a student sits at
example: Do not write on the desk.

definitionEn: to take a formal test
example: You will sit an exam in May.

definitionEn: a test where you speak, not write
example: The oral exam is five minutes long.

definitionEn: a test you complete on paper or a computer
example: The written exam has three parts.

definitionEn: a practice exam before the real one
example: The mock exam is in March.

definitionEn: the lowest result you need to succeed
example: The pass mark is fifty percent.

definitionEn: a letter or word that shows the quality of work
example: She got grade B in English.

definitionEn: a document for parents about a student's work and behaviour
example: School reports go home in June.

definitionEn: a meeting when teachers talk to parents
example: Parents' evening is on Thursday at five.

definitionEn: work done during the year that counts towards a grade
example: The project is part of your coursework.

definitionEn: the last day or time you can hand work in
example: The deadline for the essay is Friday.

definitionEn: extra time to finish work
example: Ask for an extension if you are ill.

definitionEn: hidden notes used to cheat in a test
example: A cheat sheet will get you a zero.

definitionEn: to study your written notes again
example: Revise notes for twenty minutes every evening.

definitionEn: to learn so you can remember without looking
example: Memorise the irregular verbs this week.

definitionEn: to get things wrong while you learn
example: Do not be afraid to make mistakes in speaking.

definitionEn: to listen and watch carefully
example: Pay attention when the teacher explains the task.

definitionEn: to write down the important points
example: Take notes during the film, not after.

definitionEn: to give papers to everyone in the class
example: I will hand out the tests now.

definitionEn: to take completed work from students
example: Collect in the worksheets at the end.

definitionEn: to write down what the teacher wrote on the board
example: Copy from the board the three new words.

definitionEn: to do a task with one other student
example: Work in pairs and compare answers.

definitionEn: a task done by several students together
example: Group work is ten minutes, then we share ideas.

definitionEn: a short talk to the class, often with slides
example: Each pair will give a three-minute presentation.

definitionEn: the official list of what students may and may not do
example: Mobile phones are banned by the school rules.

definitionEn: time you must stay after school as a punishment
example: Talking in the test means detention.

definitionEn: being sent home or removed from school for serious misbehaviour
example: Fighting can lead to exclusion.

definitionEn: the rules about what students must wear
example: Black shoes are part of the uniform policy.

definitionEn: food brought from home to eat at school
example: A packed lunch must not include nuts in this school.

definitionEn: a hot meal served at school
example: School dinner is cheaper if you pay in advance.

definitionEn: a card that lets you travel to school by bus
example: Show your bus pass to the driver.

definitionEn: a day when visitors can look around the school
example: Year six pupils come to our open day in June.

definitionEn: the ceremony at the end of school
example: Graduation is in the town hall this year.
